:::{#exr-se-rmse-unbiased}
#### Standard error of an unbiased estimator

Using @eq-unbiased-mse,
write the [standard error](#def-SE) of an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) estimator $\hparam$
in terms of its [pMSE](#def-mse).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-se-rmse-unbiased}

By @eq-unbiased-mse, $\pMSE{\hparam} = \Var{\hparam}$.
Taking square roots of both sides,

$$
\begin{aligned}
  \sqrt{\pMSE{\hparam}} &= \SD{\hparam} \\
  &= \SE{\hparam}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
